<!-- pr-reviewer: 85de93b9202e01dbd66f6602530a2a56ad955b1d -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- Test-only: every changed Rust file is under `crates/motion/tests/` (plus AGENTS.md and a decision record). No runtime CAM code, so generated toolpaths and posted output are unchanged.
- No dependency changes: no `Cargo.toml` / `Cargo.lock` change. The PNG diff writer is hand-rolled (`common/png.rs`), with no image crate.
- No snapshot PNGs or goldens touched.
- Verifier logic holds up on a read of `shape_mask.rs`. An overcut (a swept cell outside the expected region dilated by one cell) fails, as does an out-of-grid escape. Interior leftover fails unless a stated allowed region covers it. Ramps and helices credit only the depth they actually reach. Pre-cleared stock gives no swept-coverage credit. Negative tests pin overcut, out-of-grid, leftover, over-stepover, and symmetry/stock extension.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()` in the new helpers. Failures are deliberate `panic!`s with a message, and they are test-only.
- Process: AGENTS.md changed and `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited (the PR declares "Process change: yes"), as intended. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1768`, and the decision record is present.

**Results merged with main (locally on m5, not the runner; trial merge with upstream/main was clean)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test shape_masks --test trochoid_slot --test adaptive_hsm`: shape_masks 11 passed, trochoid_slot 12 passed, adaptive_hsm 2 passed (5 heavy tests ignored).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/motion/tests/shape_masks.rs` (488 lines) and `common/shape_mask.rs` (409) are past the ~400-line guideline. Consider splitting along the helper/generator seam later.
- The AGENTS.md hunk is a process change, so the merging session should post the pinned #681 comment with the `PROCESS_VERSION` it takes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
